fromDate.description: Send the data that was updated since this date. It only has effect if it is older than the start of the last successful sync with the server, since the data updated between them would never be sent. When there wasn't any successful sync, all the data is sent

fullSync.description: Send all the data, no matter when the last successful sync with the server was made. When true, fromDate is ignored

outbreakIDs.description: Send only the data of these outbreaks (limited to the ones accepted by the upstream server). When not sent, the outbreaks configured for the upstream server are used. Empty means all the outbreaks
